title: The First Beast, The Second Beast

questions.question: And I saw a beast rising out of the ____, with ten horns and seven heads, with ten diadems on its horns and blasphemous names on its heads.
questions.explanation: Revelation 13:1 (ESV): "And I saw a beast rising out of the sea, with ten horns and seven heads, with ten diadems on its horns and blasphemous names on its heads."

questions.question: And the beast that I saw was like a leopard; its feet were like a ____'s, and its mouth was like a ____'s mouth.
questions.explanation: Revelation 13:2 (ESV): "And the beast that I saw was like a leopard; its feet were like a bear's, and its mouth was like a lion's mouth. And to it the dragon gave his power and his throne and great authority."

questions.question: And to it the ____ gave his power and his throne and great authority.
questions.explanation: Revelation 13:2 (ESV): "...And to it the dragon gave his power and his throne and great authority."

questions.question: One of its heads seemed to have a ____ wound, but its ____ wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled as they followed the beast.
questions.explanation: Revelation 13:3 (ESV): "One of its heads seemed to have a mortal wound, but its mortal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled as they followed the beast."

questions.question: And they worshiped the dragon... and they worshiped the beast, saying, "Who is like the beast, and who can ____ against it?"
questions.explanation: Revelation 13:4 (ESV): "And they worshiped the dragon, for he had given his authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, 'Who is like the beast, and who can fight against it?'"

questions.question: And the beast was given a mouth uttering haughty and blasphemous words, and it was allowed to exercise authority for ____ months.
questions.explanation: Revelation 13:5 (ESV): "And the beast was given a mouth uttering haughty and blasphemous words, and it was allowed to exercise authority for forty-two months."

questions.question: Also it was allowed to make ____ on the saints and to conquer them.
questions.explanation: Revelation 13:7 (ESV): "Also it was allowed to make war on the saints and to conquer them. And authority was given it over every tribe and people and language and nation,"

questions.question: and all who dwell on earth will worship it, everyone whose name has not been written before the foundation of the world in the book of life of the ____ who was slain.
questions.explanation: Revelation 13:8 (ESV): "and all who dwell on earth will worship it, everyone whose name has not been written before the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who was slain."

questions.question: Then I saw another beast rising out of the ____. It had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon.
questions.explanation: Revelation 13:11 (ESV): "Then I saw another beast rising out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon."

questions.question: It performs great ____, even making fire come down from heaven to earth in front of people,
questions.explanation: Revelation 13:13 (ESV): "It performs great signs, even making fire come down from heaven to earth in front of people,"

questions.question: and by the signs that it is allowed to work... it deceives those who dwell on earth, telling them to make an ____ for the beast that was wounded by the sword and yet lived.
questions.explanation: Revelation 13:14 (ESV): "and by the signs that it is allowed to work in the presence of the beast it deceives those who dwell on earth, telling them to make an image for the beast that was wounded by the sword and yet lived."

questions.question: And it was allowed to give ____ to the image of the beast, so that the image of the beast might even speak and might cause those who would not worship the image of the beast to be slain.
questions.explanation: Revelation 13:15 (ESV): "And it was allowed to give breath to the image of the beast, so that the image of the beast might even speak and might cause those who would not worship the image of the beast to be slain."

questions.question: Also it causes all, both small and great, both rich and poor, both free and slave, to be marked on the right ____ or the ____,
questions.explanation: Revelation 13:16 (ESV): "Also it causes all, both small and great, both rich and poor, both free and slave, to be marked on the right hand or the forehead,"

questions.question: so that no one can ____ or ____ unless he has the mark, that is, the name of the beast or the number of its name.
questions.explanation: Revelation 13:17 (ESV): "so that no one can buy or sell unless he has the mark, that is, the name of the beast or the number of its name."

questions.question: This calls for wisdom: let the one who has understanding calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and his number is ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 13:18 (ESV): "This calls for wisdom: let the one who has understanding calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and his number is 666."

key_verse_text: and all who dwell on earth will worship it, everyone whose name has not been written before the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who was slain.
